arabic_html:
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَنصُرُوا۟
ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ ۞
translation: O you who have believed, if you support Allah, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: to support Allah is to support His religion — and the reply promised is twofold: He supports you, and He makes your feet firm where they would have slipped.
